about_the_game:
Fine-tuned Physical Simulation

You'll feel every impact as objects respond realistically to your actions. Watch as your moves create natural, unpredictable chain reactions that change the game with each decision you make.

Physics-bending Powers

You'll wield abilities that let you break the rules. Create force fields, manipulate momentum, and bend spatial properties to transform the environment and devise strategies limited only by your imagination.

Dynamic Boards and Opponents

You'll navigate boards packed with interactive obstacles and hazards that react to your choices. Face diverse opponents - aggressive rushers, tactical strategists, rule-bending cheaters, defensive turtlers, and more - each wielding powers with their own distinctive playstyle.

Extremely Satisfying Game Feel

You'll experience the perfect heft and trajectory with every marble you send into battle. Each collision delivers visible impact, with responsive controls and rich audio cues. Each action delivers immediate, tangible feedback.

Tap Into Childhood Excitement

You'll reconnect with that same wonder you felt playing with marbles as a kid, now enhanced with extraordinary powers. The familiar thrill of a perfect shot combined with the strategic depth of your power cards creates a game that's instantly nostalgic yet refreshingly new.

name: Stone Breaker

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10, Windows® 11, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or better AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060（VRAM 6GB）or better AMD Radeon RX 590（VRAM 8GB）or better
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 10, Windows® 11, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K or better AMD Ryzen 7 5700X or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070（VRAM 8GB）or better AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT（VRAM 8GB）or better
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: A turn-based strategy marble battle game, with physics-bending powers and dynamic boards. Defeat challengers in a strategic marble battle to progress through various areas of unique themes and acquire new power cards to build your ideal decks for the various encounters you’ll face.
